stem: Which lasting impact resulted from changes to how the federal government collects revenue following passage of the Sixteenth Amendment in 1913?

options.label: A
options.text: U.S. citizens paying higher prices for goods because of increased tariffs

options.label: B
options.text: U.S. citizens paying lower prices for goods because of the abolition of tariffs

options.label: C
options.text: U.S. citizens paying income taxes at varying rates based on level of income

options.label: D
options.text: U.S. citizens paying income taxes at the same rate regardless of level of income
